notes: No breadboard is used; the servo's three wires go directly to the Uno via jumper wires. The diagram shows the servo's own cable leading to the Uno pins, modelled here as three jumper wires from the servo connector to the Uno header.
Signal wire goes to digital pin 9 (matches attach(9) in the code and the yellow wire in the circuit image).
Power wire (red in the text, orange in the image) goes to 5V; ground (black) goes to a GND pin on the power header. The image shows it at the first GND next to 5V, modelled as GND.1.
The servo's internal parts (DC motor, gearbox, potentiometer, control circuit) are inside the servo part and not modelled separately.
The USB cable to power and program the Uno is not shown in the circuit image and is omitted.
